audit_scope: Post-training read-only audit of the completed 30-epoch reconstruction experiment.
status_reason: All directly inspectable split, artifact, checkpoint-selection, configuration, label, and reconstruction-interface checks pass. The terminal training/validation/test transcript was not persisted as a dedicated training log in the repository, so per-step runtime diagnostics (NaN/Inf messages, gradient-norm history, and optimizer-step messages) cannot be independently replayed from a log artifact. This is a traceability warning, not evidence of a failed run.

scientific_status.reason: The manifest identifies this as a deterministic VIBE-GECV-RECON-v1.0 split and the approved reconstruction contract uses custom global-scene, text-off, temporal, mask, synchrony, and K-selection decisions.

evidence: model_best.pth is not tensor-identical to model_ep30_acc0.9508_f10.9509.pth.
checkpoint_selection.test_selection_path: trainer/train_model.py: after the 30-epoch loop, torch.load(self.ckpt_dir / 'model_best.pth'), self.model.load_state_dict(best_ckpt), then self.validate(epochs, self.test_loader, mode='Test').
checkpoint_selection.selection_path: trainer/train_model.py: validation metrics are computed each epoch; only a strict improvement in metrics['macro_f1'] writes model_best.pth. checkpoint_last.pth is written after selection-state update.

data_leakage_audit.test_loader_usage: Constructed from the frozen test list but not iterated in the training loop. It is passed only to the final self.validate(..., mode='Test') call after model_best.pth is reloaded.
data_leakage_audit.validation_usage: Validation metrics are used for checkpoint selection only (best_metric=macro_f1).
data_leakage_audit.code_evidence: trainer/train_model.py uses self.val_loader inside the epoch loop; self.test_loader occurs only after that loop and after best checkpoint reload.

reconstruction_contract.audio: HDF5 audio_features [32,768] is explicitly adapted to audio_seq [B,32,768]; audio_time_mask is preserved.
reconstruction_contract.global: HDF5 global_scene [768] is explicitly passed as global_v [B,768], a single scene-calibration vector; it is not an asserted temporal global sequence and is not copied into env_feat.
reconstruction_contract.environment_feature: env_feat is None. model/vibe_model.py documents it as retained legacy-call compatibility and does not consume it.
reconstruction_contract.synchrony: HDF5 physics_sync is retained as sync_mat provenance. Stored HDF5 scalar gamma is selected by reconstruction_gamma_source=stored and reshaped to [B,1,1] for the model.
reconstruction_contract.text_and_semantic_loss: text_anch=None; enable_sat=false; lambda_sat=0.0; VIBE_Loss returns L_sat=0.

test_result_traceability.result: PASS: the supplied confusion matrix sums to exactly 61 and reproduces the supplied rounded held-out test metrics.

loss_training_sanity.checkpoint_completion_evidence: checkpoint_last.pth records epoch 30 and includes model, optimizer, and scheduler state.
loss_training_sanity.gradient_control_code: trainer/train_model.py applies torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(..., grad_clip=1.0) before optimizer.step().
loss_training_sanity.runtime_log_findings: No dedicated completed training console log was found under logs/. The available logs/gecv_reconstruction_v1.log is an extraction-status log, not the 30-epoch trainer transcript.
loss_training_sanity.observed_warning: This is a traceability limitation only; no corrupted/non-finite saved state was found.

conclusion: NEEDS_REVIEW: retain/archive the complete trainer terminal transcript (or a structured epoch-metrics artifact) alongside these checkpoints. After that provenance gap is closed, the inspected completed reconstruction run passes the requested code/data/split/checkpoint integrity checks. Its held-out test result remains a VIBE-GECV-RECON-v1.0 reconstruction result, not an official VIBE paper result.
